### Direct Your Heart
Author: Jon Bloom
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/direct-your-heart
Passage: Proverbs 23:19
Points:
- The cultural advice to follow your heart is misleading because fallen human desires can easily lead to destruction.
- Proverbs urges believers instead to intentionally direct their hearts toward truth and righteousness.
- Directing the heart involves humbly listening to godly parental guidance and wise instruction.
- Wisdom demands discerning deceptive people and staying alert to the traps of fleeting wealth, lust, and chemical addiction.
- Finding supreme delight in the Lord reorients the heart so its deepest desires align with what is truly good.
